title: OMP MCP configuration
description: Schema for mcp.json, .mcp.json, .omp/mcp.json, and ~/.omp/agent/mcp.json used by the OMP coding agent.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editor autocomplete and validation.

mcpServers.description: Map of MCP server name to server configuration.

disabledServers.description: User-level denylist for disabling discovered servers by name. Highest precedence: a server here is hidden regardless of any other source.

enabledServers.description: User-level allowlist that overrides a discovered server's `enabled: false` flag (e.g. when the source config is owned by another tool such as opencode.json). The denylist still wins.

credentialId.description: Stored OAuth credential id from agent auth storage.

clientId.description: OAuth client id persisted for refresh.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret persisted for refresh.

resource.description: MCP resource URI persisted for OAuth resource indicators.

prompt.description: OAuth `prompt` parameter sent during authorization (default: omit unless the requested scope contains `offline_access`, which sends "consent"; set to "" to always omit).

oauthConfig.description: Explicit OAuth client settings for servers that need them during /mcp reauth or initial connect.

launchApp.description: macOS app to ensure is running before spawning this stdio server. Accepts an app name (e.g. "Repo Prompt") or a full bundle path. String shorthand = background launch.

path.description: App name, full bundle path, or bundle id understood by `open -a`.

foreground.description: If true, activate the app on launch (`open -a`). Default false uses `open -gja` to launch in the background without stealing focus.

enabled.description: Whether OMP should try to connect this server.

timeout.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds (default 30000, 0 disables). Bounds individual MCP requests like tools/call; raise for long-running agent or oracle tools.

connectTimeoutMs.description: Hard cap on initialize + tools/list (default 30000, 0 disables). Bounds the startup handshake so unreachable or hung servers do not block the agent. Independent of `timeout`.

args.description: Arguments passed to the stdio server process.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the stdio process.

cwd.description: Working directory used when spawning the stdio process.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with MCP requests.

type.description: Legacy SSE transport kept for compatibility. Prefer http for new configs.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with the SSE transport.
